fixed.explanation: validate_metadata passes dtype_equal=True to array_equivalent, which skips the dtype check. When the dtypes differ (float vs int categories), this reaches a low-level comparison and raises a buffer dtype mismatch. Removing dtype_equal=True lets array_equivalent return False for different dtypes, so the intended ValueError is raised.
